label: Vologda butter
note: Russia's first protected designation of origin (2010); invented by Nikolai Vereshchagin, shown as 'Parisian butter' at Paris 1878 (gold medal); sweet, creamy, nutty

about.text: Butter from the Vologda region of Russia, known for a sweet, creamy, nutty flavour. Invented by Nikolai Vereshchagin, who won a gold medal at Paris in 1878 with it as "Parisian butter"; Russia's first protected designation of origin (2010).

how.text: The unusually hot, long heating of selected cream gives the nutty flavour that sets Vologda butter apart from ordinary pasteurised sweet-cream butter.
